plan.title: Partial award and empty approval remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable partial quantity awarding required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case setup.
Open the awarding page for the two-bid event.
Allocate only 6 of the requested 10 units to Vendor B.
Verify one of two vendors is awarded and the proposal value is 6 × 90 = 540.
Open the proposal page after the partial allocation.
Verify navigation to the proposal page.
Verify the proposal identifies Vendor B as the awarded vendor.
Verify the proposal shows the partial award value of 540.
Verify the proposal shows the awarded quantity of 6.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify the proposal was created and submitted.
